summary: Kindergarten teacher urges preservation of E-Rate program as essential investment in educational opportunity for students with limited resources. The comment supports preserving E-Rate funding for educational access and success.

claims.argument: Reducing E-Rate funding would place an additional financial burden on school districts.
claims.evidence_quote: Reducing or eliminating E-Rate funding would place an additional financial burden on school districts that are already working hard to meet the needs of their students with limited resources.
